title: Technical Officer in Applied Chemistry
description:
THE PAPUA NEW GUINEA UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY
The Papua New Guinea University of Technology (PNG UoT) is seeking a qualified and motivated individual to join the School of Applied Sciences as a
Technical Officer in Applied Chemistry
. Reporting to the Laboratory Manager, this vital role supports the academic and research functions of the department through the effective management of laboratory operations, technical instruction, and maintenance of scientific equipment including participation in the School’s external consultancy activities.
Primary Responsibilities:
Prepare and maintain laboratory materials, reagents, and equipment for undergraduate and postgraduate chemistry practical sessions
Provide technical assistance to academic staff during teaching laboratories and research experiments
Ensure compliance with laboratory safety protocols and assist with risk assessments
Maintain inventory records and oversee routine calibration and servicing of lab equipment
Assist in the procurement of laboratory supplies and consumables
Qualifications and Experience:
Bachelor's degree in Applied Chemistry, Chemical Technology, or a related field
Minimum of two (2) years’ experience in a laboratory-based technical role, preferably in an academic or research environment
Proficiency in handling analytical instruments (e.g., spectrophotometers, chromatographs)
Sound understanding of chemical safety procedures and inventory management
Strong organizational and communication skills
Additional Attributes:
Ability to work collaboratively with faculty, students, and staff
Commitment to supporting academic excellence through reliable technical support
Self-motivated and capable of working independently under minimal supervision
Condition of Service
Technical Officer I/II                       PGK26,709 - PGK38,241 per annum
Domestic Market Allowance             PGK1,200
(Level of appointment depends upon qualification and experience)
Application Procedure
Detailed application with curriculum vitae including certified copies of qualifications, names and addresses including email addresses, phone numbers of three (3) current referees including one from past/present employer, if any, should be sent to the address below:
The Executive Director - Human Resources
PNG University of Technology
Private Mail Bag
Lae, 411
Papua New Guinea
